nodes.question: Can nudging and boosting strategies help in steering or empowering good decisions?
nodes.answer: Yes, nudging and boosting strategies can be effective in both steering individuals towards making better decisions and empowering them to make choices that align with their goals. These strategies can help in influencing behaviour positively without restricting freedom of choice.
